blocks.text: Dear Harvest Partner, In this monthly letter we’re going to discover some very important events in the life of the Elect. These are only a few, but are very important. First, let us lay a foundation. Since the beginning of time our Lord has walked with each and every age in the Bible guiding the prophets and His people, always caring and guiding them in the direction of the truth. (St. John 16:13) He is ever close to each and every individual. We are approaching the very hour that the world will make its greatest changes. Just a little note to let you know that whatever the governments on a worldwide basis are trying to do they will only prolong the major event that will bring the anti-Christ. The trouble is not only in the U.S.A. but also in Europe and other parts of the world. There is a rumor that Europe is talking about bringing back the Bretton Woods Act. This event would place gold in all or part of their currency. That would leave the U.S. to restore the same type of system making an image unto this new system. Gold has a number and that number is 999 fine. All of these events will lead to a dramatic end. Everywhere we look we see God’s signs warning people the age is terminating. The world event that looms in the not too distant future is Armageddon. In every direction on the globe we see prophecy fulfilling! We are reaching the turning point in world affairs. The anti-Christ system is preparing to bring about changes and are going over subtle plans even now. Also on the other hand we are entering the turning point for the Elect! The Lord will be working in bringing in new ones from the harvest. He will give a refreshing anointing preparing us for translation. We are turning the prophetic corner and Jesus is coming very soon! – To continue this letter I want to go directly to Brother Neal Frisby’s quote.

“It’s wonderful to know the Lord foreknew you and the very hour you would work with this ministry in helping! In fact Paul gives us valuable insight along with many more Bible writers concerning God’s foreknowledge! Wherein we know the Jews rejected the Headstone, but the Bride receives it as her Headship!” – Rom. 9:32-33, “For they ‘stumbled’ at that stumbling stone!” It is written, “behold I lay in Sion a stumbling stone and a ROCK of offence! And whosoever believeth on Him shall ‘not be’ ashamed!” – “It’s a wonderful mystery to know God predestinated a seed that He will visit at the end.” – “Yes, the world and lukewarm churches will be offended by the very true elect! But they will have the rock of offence, the divine love stone of the ages hovering with them!” Rom. 9:11 reveals, “the purpose of God by election might stand, not of works, but of Him that calleth!” – Eph. 1:4-5, “Who foreknew us and predestinated us before the foundation of the world!” – “In I Peter 2:8-9, reveals the elect would be chosen by the Rock of Offence, and will be called a peculiar and royal people!” – Rom. 11:5, “The Lord always has a remnant according to his election of grace!” – In Rom. 10:15, “How beautiful are them that preach the gospel of peace; and bring glad tidings of good things!” Those who work and help in this ministry and love the Lord Jesus fulfill this Scripture, and are foreknown in Rom. 8:29, “He did foreknow and did predestinate!” “It is good to know that God has a plan for each of us and we will fold into His wings of divine providence! He has a place prepared in eternity for each one! Jesus loves you and is very close to you at the moment of this reading!”

And for the Elect here are some promises to remember for the days ahead! I Kings 17:14, “For thus saith the Lord the meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail.” – “In other words, He will provide! – His blessings will overtake you!” (Deut. 28:2) – “For the Lord hath pleasure in the prosperity of His servant!” (Or servants) Ps. 35:27 – “Wealth and riches shall be in His house! (Ps. 112:1,3) As you give it shall be given to you! (Luke 6:38) –Prove Me now saith the Lord!” (Mal. 3:10) – “The Lord will open unto thee His good treasure!” (Deut. 28:12) – “He will command a blessing upon thee!” (Deut. 28:8) – “He will give thee power to prosper!” (Deut. 8:18) “No matter in hard times you will still have good success! (Josh. 1:8) – Give and thou shalt have treasure in heaven! (Matt. 19:21) You will be plenteous in goods!” (Deut. 28:11) So be positive! Remember these truths!” End quote.

This month I’m going to release two new Special Writings called “The Revelation of God’s People” as well as “The Appointed Time.” They reveal many prophetic events and secrets. You will want to have them in your library to study. Also I am releasing a special DVD called “The One and Only God.” (See below.) This month I am asking you to do the very best you can to help us with all of the projects we have scheduled as well as we are sending material to our new partners. You will have a part in this wonderful giving of Brother Frisby’s timely gospel message. I want to thank each and every one of you for your prayers and your support. May God bless and keep each and every one of you in the days ahead. Your Brother in Christ,
